Name: Chandra
Description: Chandra helped rescue Terrax, Paibok and Infant Terrible from their crashing vessel. She asked them to use their great powers to help free her and the other slaves from their oppressor - Randau the Space Parasite. She tried to appeal to Terrax's emotions but failed. He only was able to hear her words after she was killed by Randau.
